description: This file is a FastAPI application implementation that provides REST API endpoints for managing certification jobs, including health checks, creating, retrieving, and patching certification jobs, handling webhooks from GitLab and Airflow, as well as managing mappings and metadata. It orchestrates background tasks for certification workflows and handles incoming webhook events, integrating with database models and external orchestration processes.

classes.name: HealthResponse
classes.description: Response model for health check endpoints.

classes.name: CertificationRunResponse
classes.description: Response model representing details of a certification job.

classes.name: MappingResponse
classes.description: Response model for branch-environment mapping details.

classes.name: MetadataItemResponse
classes.description: Response model for metadata item details.
